issues.description: The Stock API name for adding a StockIngredient differs between artifacts. The problem statement UML declares a method named addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient) (problem_statement.md) while the template implementation defines a method named addItem(StockIngredient) in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java. The provided solution implements addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient). This naming mismatch will confuse students following the UML/spec and can cause compilation or test failures if graders/tests expect addToStockIngredients but the starter code only exposes addItem.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the starter code's Stock API match the problem specification and solution. Either rename the template method addItem(StockIngredient) to addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient) (updating all internal calls), or add a new public wrapper method addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient ingredient) that delegates to addItem(ingredient). This preserves pedagogical intent while avoiding confusion and potential compilation/test failures.
